_readme: Your edits to the Dana Brown Predictor. The model proposes, this file overrules.
Edit it, commit it, re-run the Deadline outlook workflow. Anything you leave empty keeps the model's answer.
Player names are matched loosely — accents, punctuation and capitalization don't matter. 'jesus sanchez' finds Jesús Sánchez.
If a name doesn't match anyone, the run does NOT fail. It skips that line and lists it under 'Override warnings' in reports/deadline-outlook.md.
Values and the balance bar always recalculate themselves — never type a number.
hide  — kill a prediction. Use the TARGET's name (the player coming to Houston).
edit  — keyed by target name. 'pkg' replaces the whole return; 'note' writes the italic line under the card.
add   — a trade the model never proposed. 'target' is who Houston gets, 'pkg' is what Houston sends.
If the target is already predicted, your version replaces it.
order — the running order. Names listed here lead in that order; everything else follows behind.

_examples._comment: Delete the leading underscore on any key below to switch it on. Kept here as a copy-paste reference.
